level.name: 비행기를 놓칠 뻔했어요
level.nameEn: 2B Unit 17 · I almost missed the flight
level.description: Farm the Unit 17 word list — the things that go wrong in a day, the colours and patterns you describe a lost bag with, and the words for getting it back.
level.descriptionEn: Learn to say what almost happened, describe a lost item by its colour and pattern, and report it — with illustrated vocabulary, listening practice and workbook exercises.
